name: reminders
description: Use the OS reminders integration to query and manage native macOS Reminders.app, listing reminder lists, fetching reminders by list or due date, creating new reminders, updating, completing, or deleting them. Use whenever the user asks about reminders or to-dos, for example "remind me to call the client tomorrow", "what's on my errands list", or "mark that reminder done". Use even when you think you know the answer, Reminders state is dynamic, only the live API reflects current items, due dates, and completion status. Do not use for non-macOS systems, other reminder/task apps (Todoist, TickTick, etc.), or anything outside the user's local Reminders.app.
